<Heading

  children={"查询子设备入网结果"}
>
</Heading>

<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/gateways/subdevices/bindResult"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



查询指定子设备的入网绑定结果，可通过 protocols（协议类型） 和 gatewaySubdeviceFilters（网关及其子设备过滤条件）进行灵活筛选，支持同时按多协议及多个网关/子设备组合查询。


<Heading
  id={"request"}
  as={"h2"}
  className={"openapi-tabs__heading"}
  children={"Request"}
>
</Heading>

>
  
</ParamsDetails>

  title={"Body"}
  body={{"required":true,"content":{"application/json":{"schema":{"type":"object","required":["gatewaySubdeviceFilters"],"properties":{"protocols":{"type":"array","nullable":true,"description":"指定待查询的子设备协议类型。不传时，表示不限制协议类型。","items":{"type":"string","enum":["zigbee","matter"]}},"gatewaySubdeviceFilters":{"type":"array","description":"gatewayId 与子设备 ID 组合的过滤条件（必填）","items":{"type":"object","required":["gatewayId"],"properties":{"gatewayId":{"type":"string","description":"网关设备 ID。"},"subDeviceIds":{"type":"array","nullable":true,"description":"子设备 ID 列表。允许为空或不传：\n- 为空或不传：查询指定网关下的全部子设备（仅按 gatewayId 过滤）\n- 非空：查询指定网关下的指定子设备（按 gatewayId + subDeviceIds 过滤）\n","items":{"type":"string"}}},"title":"GatewaySubdeviceDidFilter"}},"bindTime":{"type":"integer","format":"int64","nullable":true,"description":"入网结果查询的绑定时间，单位毫秒。"}},"title":"DeviceBindResultRequest"},"examples":{"queryByGatewayAndSubDevices":{"value":{"protocols":["zigbee","matter"],"gatewaySubdeviceFilters":[{"gatewayId":"gateway-001","subDeviceIds":[]},{"gatewayId":"gateway-001","subDeviceIds":["subdevice-001","subdevice-002"]},{"gatewayId":"gateway-002","subDeviceIds":["subdevice-101"]}]}}}}}}}
>
  
</RequestSchema>
